Also fix git diff --check whitespace/EOF errors and the 123-character commit subject causing required Commit trailers CI failure.

Changes requested: independent focused suite is 49 passed, 1 failed: test_failed_receipt_recovery_for_exact_original_packet_id raises KeyError 'agents' after direct state mutation. More fundamentally, that test manually writes ai-status.json and os.replace()s failed to pending, so it does not prove the required governed exact-id recovery mechanism. Implement and exercise a governed recovery entrypoint for the original failed packet id, preserving packet/spec/provenance fail-closed checks; do not hand-edit queue/state. On nonzero assign, use governed authoritative show/readback (not repo-local candidate scan) before continuing. The current new test uses a file-only fake repo. 3) Repair PR #4658 delivery: Commit trailers fails because 20dede829 subject is 83 chars (>72); use the approved non-force workflow and rerun CI. Remove the trailing blank line too.

(2) the nonzero-assign path only calls _materialized_task_candidates(repo_root, task_id), not the authoritative governed readback; test currently flips returncode after a successful local subprocess.
